blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Text-to-image diffusion models have achieved remarkable progress in image synthesis, yet can exhibit memorization by closely reproducing individual training examples. Effective mitigation must preserve useful prompt information to guide alternative depictions. We introduce a training-free method that redistributes cross-attention with Gaussian smoothing before reinforcing content-token contributions and attenuating padding contributions, without additional denoiser evaluations. With this intervention, stronger content conditioning can improve prompt alignment at comparable training-image similarity. A local analysis identifies when reinforcement preserves shared value information while redistribution reduces localized attention mass. On Stable Diffusion v1.4 and v2.0, all evaluated smoothing widths lie on the empirical Pareto frontiers for training-image similarity versus both prompt alignment and image preference. A configuration selected on Stable Diffusion reduces template reproduction in DeepFloyd IF without further tuning. These findings support jointly controlling conditioning allocation and strength to generate prompt-consistent alternatives.
blocks.zh: 文本到图像传播模型在图像合成方面取得了显著进展,但可以通过密切复制个别培训实例来展示记忆。 有效的缓解措施必须及时保存有用的信息,以指导替代性描述。 我们采用了一种无培训方法,在加强内容汇合的贡献和减少补足的贡献之前,重新分配与高斯平滑的交叉关注,而不进行更多的贬低评价。 有了这种干预,加强内容调节可以改善在类似培训形象方面的迅速调整。 局部分析确定何时加强保留共享价值信息,而再分配则减少局部关注质量. 在稳定扩散v1.4和v2.0中,所有评估的平滑宽度都位于经验性的Pareto边框上,用于训练-图像相似性与即时对齐和图像偏好。 在Stable Difusion上选择的配置在DeepFloyd IF中减少了模板复制而无需进一步调试. 这些结论支持联合控制调节配置和强度,以产生迅速一致的替代品。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Text-to-image diffusion models enable high-quality image synthesis from natural-language descriptions ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2021b ; Rombach et al., 2022 ; Ramesh et al., 2022 ; Saharia et al., 2022 ) . Yet these models can exhibit memorization : certain prompts elicit close reproductions of individual training images ( Carlini et al., 2023 ; Somepalli et al., 2023a ; Somepalli et al., 2023b ; Webster, 2023 ) . Such reproduction can preserve a training image’s distinctive composition and visual details, beyond the semantic resemblance expected from depicting the same subject. Mitigating this behavior requires more than moving the generated image away from a training reference: the model must still produce a useful alternative that follows the prompt. A prompt generally permits many valid depictions, and its objects, attributes, and context provide information for constructing them. Figure 1 illustrates this goal: the film context in the Emma Watson/Belle prompt supports an alternative depiction of the subject.
blocks.zh: 文本到图像传播模型能够从自然语言描述中进行高质量的图像合成 (Ho等人,2020年;Song等人,2021b;Rombach等人,2022年;Ramesh等人,2022年;Saharia等人,2022年). 然而,这些模型可以显示记忆:某些提示引起对个人训练图像的密切复制(Carlini等人,2023年;Somepalli等人,2023年a;Somepalli等人,2023年b;Webster,2023年) 。 这种复制可以保存训练形象的独特组成和视觉细节,超出描绘同一主题的语义相似性。 减缓这种行为需要的不仅仅是将生成的图像从训练参考物中移走:模型仍然必须产生一个跟随提示的有用的替代物. 迅速一般允许许多有效的描述,其对象、属性和上下文为构建它们提供了信息。 图1说明了这一目标:艾玛·沃森/贝勒(Emma Watson/Belle)的电影背景支持对该主题的另类描绘.

blocks.en: Several inference-time approaches mitigate memorization by weakening or avoiding conditional responses associated with reproduction. Prompt-embedding adjustment reduces the magnitude of text-conditional guidance ( Wen et al., 2024 ) , while initial-noise adjustment seeks starting points with weaker conditional responses and earlier escape from memorization basins ( Han et al., 2025 ) . Other approaches postpone or reverse guidance ( Jain et al., 2025 ) , or reduce attention to prompt words ( Ren et al., 2024 ) . We instead make content reinforcement an active part of mitigation: strengthening useful prompt information to guide alternative depictions.
blocks.zh: 几种推论时间方法通过削弱或避免与繁殖有关的有条件反应来缓解记忆. 快速嵌入调整降低了文本条件指导的大小(Wen等人,2024年),而初始噪声调整则寻求以较弱的有条件反应以及更早脱离记忆盆地的起点(Han等人,2025年). 其他办法推迟或反向指导(Jain等人,2025年),或减少注意即时词(Ren等人,2024年)。 相反,我们使内容强化成为缓解的一个积极部分:加强有用的及时信息,指导其他描述。

blocks.en: We find that content reinforcement can improve prompt alignment at comparable training-image similarity. This improvement occurs when content gain is increased with redistribution and padding attenuation held fixed, showing that reinforcement can support useful conditioning during mitigation. We implement this approach as a training-free cross-attention intervention that combines content amplification with Gaussian redistribution and selective padding attenuation. Early smoothing changes the allocation of attention across token positions; amplification then strengthens the redistributed content contributions. The intervention retains the original prompt and frozen model and requires no additional denoiser evaluations.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,内容强化可以改进在类似培训形象方面的迅速调整。 这种改进是随着固定的再分配和加固减值而增加内容增益时发生的,这表明加固可以支持缓解过程中的有益条件。 我们将此方法作为免费培训的交叉关注干预,将内容扩展与高斯再分配和有选择地抑制减弱结合起来。 及早平稳地改变各种象征性立场的注意力分配;扩大后加强重新分配的内容贡献。 该干预保留了最初的即时和冻结模式,不需要额外的DENOISER评价.

(a) An illustrative attention row shows Gaussian redistribution followed by content reinforcement and padding attenuation, on a shared scale. (b) Recorded outputs illustrate an alternative depiction that retains the prompt context.
blocks.zh: 图 1:加强重新分配的调节模式。 (a) 一个说明性关注栏显示,高斯再分配,然后是内容加固和加固减退,采用共同规模。 (b) 记录的产出说明一种保留及时背景的替代描述。

blocks.en: Redistribution improves the suppression–quality balance of this reinforcement strategy. At fixed token gains in our main configuration, Gaussian redistribution recovers prompt alignment and image preference over reweighting alone while retaining most of the suppression. A local analysis complements these generation-level results: under value-coherence conditions, an admissible gain preserves shared feature information while reducing the attention component’s mass on its original token set. Together, these results explain how controlling attention allocation supports reinforcement during mitigation.
blocks.zh: 重新分配可以改善这种强化战略的抑制-质量平衡。 在我们的主配置中固定的象征收益中,高斯再分配恢复了快速对齐和图像偏好,而不是仅仅重压,同时保留了大部分压制. 本地分析补充了这些生成层面的结果:在价值一致性条件下,可接受收益保留了共享的特征信息,同时减少了关注部分在原代号集上的质量. 这些结果共同解释了控制注意力分配如何支持缓解期间的加强。

blocks.en: On two Stable Diffusion benchmarks, all evaluated smoothing widths lie on the empirical Pareto frontiers for training-image similarity versus prompt alignment and image preference. A direction–norm control shows that suppression persists after restoring guidance magnitude. Our configuration selected on Stable Diffusion also transfers to DeepFloyd IF without IF-specific tuning. These findings support content reinforcement as a means of generating useful alternatives while mitigating reproduction.
blocks.zh: 在两个稳定传播基准上,所有评估的平滑宽度都位于经验性的Pareto边界上,用于培训-图像相似性与即时调整和图像偏好。 方向-规范控制表明,在恢复导量后,抑制作用继续存在。 在稳定扩散中选择的配置也转移到DeepFloyd IF,而不使用IF特定调值. 这些结论支持强化内容,作为产生有用替代品、同时减少繁殖的手段。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Training-image extraction and replication studies show that diffusion models can reproduce individual training examples ( Carlini et al., 2023 ; Somepalli et al., 2023a ) . Data duplication and image–caption associations influence this behavior ( Somepalli et al., 2023b ; Somepalli et al., 2023a ; Chen et al., 2024 ) . Mechanistic analyses locate memorization-related neurons in cross-attention layers ( Hintersdorf et al., 2024 ) , while geometric analyses explain memorization through the relationship between learned and data manifolds ( Ross et al., 2025 ) . Reproduction also takes different forms: Webster (2023) documents both image and template reproduction, and Bright Ending ( Chen et al., 2025 ) examines local memorization in which only part of an image is copied. These perspectives provide complementary accounts of what is reproduced and how memorization is represented in the model.
blocks.zh: 培训图像提取和推广研究表明,传播模型可以复制个别培训实例(Carlini等人,2023年;Somepalli等人,2023年a年)。 数据重复和图像-封装协会影响这种行为(Somepalli等人,2023b;Somepalli等人,2023a;Chen等人,2024年)。 机械分析将与记忆有关的神经元定位于交叉观察层(Hintersdorf等人,2024年),而几何分析则通过学习和数据多面之间的关系来解释记忆(Ross等人,2025年). 复制形式也不同: Webster (2023) 记录了图像和模板复制,以及Bright Ending(Chen et al., 2025) 检查仅复制部分图像的局部记忆. 这些观点对模型中转载的内容以及如何体现记忆提供了补充说明。

blocks.en: Existing methods intervene at different points in generation. Random prompt perturbations disrupt the conditioning associated with reproduction ( Somepalli et al., 2023b ) , while gradient-based prompt adjustment optimizes text embeddings to reduce the magnitude of text-conditional noise predictions ( Wen et al., 2024 ) . Guidance-based methods delay or reverse classifier-free guidance to escape memorization basins ( Jain et al., 2025 ) ; Anti-Memorization Guidance combines guidance terms targeting image duplication, caption duplication, and prompt specificity ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . Initial-noise adjustment searches for starting points that permit earlier escape from memorization basins ( Han et al., 2025 ) . Bright Ending ( Chen et al., 2025 ) localizes copied regions using EOS-token attention at the final denoising step and uses the resulting spatial mask to focus detection and prompt optimization on those regions. For direct attention modification, Ren et al. (2024) combine summary-token masking with an increase in the start-of-sequence (SOS) token’s logit before softmax; the latter shifts attention toward SOS and reduces the attention weights assigned to prompt words. Our method instead redistributes attention across token positions before reinforcing content contributions, preserving the original prompt and initial noise without input optimization.
blocks.zh: 现有方法在一代人的不同阶段进行干预。 随机即时扰动会干扰与复制相关的条件(Somepalli等人,2023b),而基于梯度的即时调整会优化文本嵌入,以减少文本条件噪声预测的大小(Wen等人,2024). 基于指导性方法的延迟或无逆向分类器的引导以逃避记忆盆地(Jain等人,2025年); 指导结合了针对图像重复、标题重复和迅速具体化的指导术语(Chen等人,2024年)。 初始-噪声调整搜索起始点,以便更早地逃离记忆盆地(Han等人,2025年)。 Bright Ending(Chen 等人,2025年)在最终解密步骤时使用EOS-token的注意力将复制区域本地化,并使用由此产生的空间掩码将探测焦点集中到这些区域上并迅速优化. 对于直接的注意修改,Ren等人(2024年)将即时敲打面具和增加序列(SOS)符符符在软马克之前的对数相结合;后者将注意力转向SOS,并减少分配给即时词的注意力重量. 相反,我们的方法在强化内容贡献之前,在象征性位置上重新分配注意力,保持原始的迅速和初始噪音,而不优化输入。

blocks.en: Cross-attention control also supports the expression of prompt semantics. Prompt-to-Prompt ( Hertz et al., 2023 ) reuses attention maps to preserve spatial layout during text-based image editing. Structured Diffusion ( Feng et al., 2023 ) incorporates linguistic structure into cross-attention guidance to improve compositional generation. SynGen ( Rassin et al., 2023 ) uses syntactic relations to align the attention maps of entities and their modifiers, improving attribute binding. Attend-and-Excite ( Chefer et al., 2023 ) addresses neglected subjects by smoothing their spatial attention maps and iteratively optimizing the latent to strengthen their activations. We share the goal of making generated images more faithfully reflect prompt content. Our intervention redistributes attention along token positions and directly amplifies the resulting content contributions, coupling this semantic objective with memorization mitigation rather than optimizing a subject-specific spatial attention objective.
blocks.zh: 交叉注意控制也支持即时语义的表达. 快速到Prompt(Hertz等人,2023年)在基于文本的图像编辑过程中重复使用关注图,以保持空间布局. 结构化扩散(Feng等人,2023年)将语言结构纳入交叉注意力指导,以改善成分生成. SynGen (Rassin et al., 2023) 使用合成关系来调和实体及其修饰者的注意力图,改进属性绑定. Att-and-Excite(Chefer等人,2023年)通过平滑其空间注意力图和反复优化潜伏以强化其激活,解决被忽略的主题. 我们共同的目标是使生成的图像更忠实地反映迅速的内容。 我们的干预按照象征性的立场重新分配注意力,并直接扩大由此产生的内容贡献,使这一语义目标与减轻记忆相结合,而不是优化针对特定主题的空间关注目标。

blocks.en: 3 Reinforcing redistributed cross-attention
blocks.zh: 3. 加强重新分配的交叉注意力

blocks.en: We reinforce prompt content to support useful alternatives during mitigation, while controlling its allocation across token positions (Figure 1 ). We first redistribute attention, then reinforce content within the resulting pattern and selectively attenuate padding contributions. This order makes amplification act on a new mixture of token values. We formalize the operator, analyze reinforcement with localized dilution, and adapt it to DeepFloyd IF.
blocks.zh: 我们强化了及时的内容,以支持在缓解措施期间的有用替代办法,同时控制其象征性位置的分配(图1)。 我们首先重新分配注意力,然后在由此产生的模式中强化内容,并有选择地减少捐款。 这个顺序使符号值的新组合上的行为放大. 我们把操作器正式化,分析加固 与局部稀释, 并使其适应 DeepFloyd IF。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate whether redistribution and reinforcement can jointly reduce training-image similarity while retaining prompt-consistent generation. After benchmarking the suppression–quality trade-off, we test whether stronger content conditioning remains useful during mitigation (Figure 4 ), whether redistribution improves the trade-off at fixed token gains (Table 1 ), and whether the effect is explained by guidance magnitude alone (Table 2 ). We then examine the EOS suppression boundary, transfer to a different model family, and selective application with an existing detector.
blocks.zh: 我们评价再分配和加强能否共同减少培训形象的相似性,同时保持迅速一致的一代。 在设定抑制-质量权衡的基准之后,我们检验在缓解措施期间,强化内容调节是否仍然有用(图4),再分配是否改善固定象征性收益的权衡(表1),以及是否仅用指导量来解释效果(表2)。 然后我们检查EOS压制边界,转移到不同的模型家族,并用现有的探测器进行选择性应用.

blocks.en: The baseline benchmark uses 500 memorized prompts for SD v1.4 and 219 for SD v2.0 from prior work ( Webster, 2023 ; Ren et al., 2024 ) . We generate ten images per prompt with 50 steps and CFG scale 7, using DDIM ( Song et al., 2021a ) for v1.4 and Euler for v2.0. Baselines are random token addition (RTA; Somepalli et al., 2023b ), gradient-based prompt adjustment (GPA; Wen et al., 2024 ), cross-attention scaling (CS; Ren et al., 2024 ), opposite guidance with a dynamic transition point (DTP; Jain et al., 2025 ), and initial-noise adjustment (AIN; Han et al., 2025 ). Figure 2 includes every recorded operating point.

blocks.en: With Gaussian redistribution and padding suppression retained, λ w = 2 \lambda_{w}=2 yields higher CLIP than λ w = 1 \lambda_{w}=1 at comparable SSCD, as shown in Figure 4 . This improvement shows that stronger content conditioning can support prompt alignment without undoing the achieved suppression. Between these endpoints, SSCD responds non-monotonically: it first rises and then falls back to a comparable level at gain 2, while the wider sweep to 3 extends this decline. In the accompanying example, at λ w = 1 \lambda_{w}=1 the pillow is blue but the guitar is brown; at λ w = 2 \lambda_{w}=2 , the guitar itself is blue, matching the requested attribute. These observations support reinforcement as a means of expressing useful prompt information during mitigation, without uniformly strengthening reproduction of the training reference. This generation-level behavior complements the local compatibility result in Eq. ( 8 ), which identifies when reinforcement preserves shared value information while redistribution reduces localized attention mass.

blocks.en: To isolate the contribution of redistribution, we compare the main Gaussian operator with reweighting alone at fixed token gains. blocks.en: 4.7 Transfer to DeepFloyd IF
blocks.zh: 4.7 转让给IF公司

blocks.en: We test whether our SD-selected configuration transfers to T5-conditioned, pixel-space IF without target-specific tuning. Using template annotations ( Webster, 2023 ) , we evaluate 48 template-verbatim (TV) prompts across 11 shared-reference groups and three seeds (144 images per arm). As shown in Table 3 , our method reduces template matches from 38.89% to 20.14%. This reduction under the SD-selected settings shows that the intervention can suppress reproduction with a different text encoder and generation space. CLIP and ImageReward also decrease relative to the base model, so the transferred configuration retains a suppression benefit with a quality cost.
blocks.zh: 我们测试我们的SD选择的配置是否转移到T5条件,像素空间IF,没有特定目标调值. 使用模板说明(Webster, 2023), 我们评价48个模板-verbatim(TV)提示, 如表3所示,我们的方法将模板匹配率从38.89%降至20.14%。 在SD选择设置下的这种减少表明,干预可以用不同的文本编码器和生成空间来压制复制. CLIP和Image Reward也相对基模型下降,因此被转移的配置保留了具有质量成本的压制效益.

blocks.en: 4.8 Selective mitigation with an existing detector
blocks.zh: 4.8 带有现有探测器的选择性缓解

blocks.en: To limit intervention on ordinary prompts, we intervene at full strength ( σ = 4 \sigma=4 ) only on inputs flagged by the initial-step guidance detector of Wen et al. (2024) . At a calibrated 5% false-positive rate, mean SSCD on 500 memorized prompts falls from 0.5486 to 0.3475, versus 0.2078 when every prompt is treated. Average ImageReward changes by − 0.0065 -0.0065 over normal prompts and − 0.1291 -0.1291 within the flagged normal subset. Because unflagged inputs follow the original generation path, selective application preserves most normal generations while still reducing reproduction. Its weaker suppression than universal application reflects the memorization-prone prompts left untreated.
blocks.zh: 为了限制对普通提示的干预,我们只用Wen等人(2024年)的初始步导探测器标注的输入,以全速(σ=4\sigma=4)进行干预。 以5%的误差率计算,500个可记住的提示的SSCD从0.5486下降到0.3475, 而在每一次提示得到处理时,则下降到0.2078。 平均图像报酬比正常的提示值变化−0.0065 - 0.0065,在标记的正常子集内变化−0.1291-0.1291。 由于未加标记的输入遵循原始生成路径,选择性应用保留了大多数正常的世代,同时仍然减少复制. 其抑制力比普遍适用弱,反映了容易被记忆的诱发物得不到治疗。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We show that stronger content conditioning within redistributed attention can improve prompt alignment at comparable training-image similarity, making reinforcement an active means of generating useful alternatives during mitigation. The local analysis identifies conditions under which reinforcement preserves shared value information while redistribution dilutes localized attention, and controlled comparisons show quality recovery from redistribution at fixed token gains. Our method attains empirical Pareto-frontier performance on two Stable Diffusion benchmarks. An SD-selected configuration also reduces template reproduction in DeepFloyd IF without further tuning. The resulting principle is to reinforce useful prompt content during mitigation, using redistribution to improve the balance between reproduction suppression and prompt-consistent generation.
blocks.zh: 我们表明,在重新分配的注意力范围内加强内容调节,可以改进在类似培训形象上的迅速调整,使加强成为缓解期间产生有用替代办法的积极手段。 地方分析确定了在何种条件下加强能保存共享价值信息,而再分配则会淡化局部关注,有控制的比较显示在固定象征性收益下从再分配中的质量恢复。 我们的方法在两个稳定扩散基准上实现了经验性的Pareto-frontier性能. 一种SD选择的配置在DeepFloyd IF中也减少了模板复制而不再进行调试. 由此产生的原则是加强减缓期间有用的即时内容,利用再分配改善抑制生殖和即时生成之间的平衡。

blocks.en: The gain interval couples dilution to coherence. Wider smoothing can reduce retention on a localized set while increasing the transport-distance bound on feature distortion. Content reinforcement compensates for the latter within the admissible interval. After the early smoothing window, G = I G=I and the local interval disappears; subsequent reweighting acts on attention along the already modified trajectory. The analysis therefore motivates early redistribution coupled with reinforcement, while the reported schedule and gains are empirical design choices. The gain sweep and the row-mass and direction/norm controls assess the resulting allocation–strength trade-off through prompt alignment, image preference, and training-image similarity.

blocks.en: The controlled SD studies use DDIM ( Song et al., 2021a ) with 50 steps, CFG scale 7, and 512 × 512 512\times 512 outputs. Redistribution and guidance controls use a common 340-prompt subset of the 500-prompt benchmark, comprising 264 template-memorization (TM) and 76 verbatim-memorization (VM) prompts. The subset is stratified by memorization type, with identical captions and shared recorded ground-truth identifiers kept in the same partition. These controls use two seeds and four images per prompt and seed, with matched initial random draws across settings. blocks.en: The EOS boundary changes the suppression–quality trade-off. At each fixed width, extending attenuation to EOS lowers SSCD together with CLIP and ImageReward (Table 7 ). The EOS-suppressed variant reaches a lower minimum SSCD (0.1382 versus 0.1453), accompanied by lower alignment and preference. Preserving EOS therefore retains prompt information and image preference while maintaining substantial suppression.
